tierReasoning: Two-file, ~45-LOC fix with no production behaviour change: the chat.db hard-link helper gains a messagesDir parameter whose default is unchanged in production and a never-created stand-in under the test runner. No block/allow surface, no session lifecycle, no gate/sentinel/guard; a revert fully restores the prior behaviour.

causalAutopsy.notes: Latent since the iMessage chat.db auto-hardlink feature (commit 85812e19f, 2026-04-12): ensureChatDbHardlink always used os.homedir()/Library/Messages, so any test constructing the adapter without dbPath reached the real Messages DB. It stayed invisible because macOS answered with a fast EPERM and the adapter fell back silently. Surfaced 2026-11-20 ~12:46 PST after the Studio rebuild changed that machine TCC posture: link() on the TCC-protected file now parks on a Full Disk Access approval (kernel: watchdog expired for approval entry, kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAllFiles) that no one at an unattended machine answers, freezing vitest workers until the 40-min lane deadline. The M5 never changed posture and kept passing. Environment shift exposed a latent defect; the fix removes the test-time reach rather than depending on either posture.
